thread:
ana: Acme POC asked for a short IR section to drop into the SOW. They want timelines, CC list, and who pays for forensics. can we make a tight blurb?

colin: Here

- Acknowledge: We will acknowledge confirmed incidents to the customerontact within 72 hours of detection.
- Hosted: Redwood performs initial triage and provides periodic updates; full written report typically 7-30 days. POC target: 10 business days.
- Private / On-prem / VPC: Customer owns infra-level forensics; Redwood will assist with evidence collection on request and provide guidance.
- Dedicated / Reserved: Prioritized triage (typically 24-48h) and expanded telemetry exports if in scope.

ravi: Add: we never promise regulatory filings unless contract explicitly requires it. phrase it carefully.

megan: CC suggestion for initial notify: customer security lead, customer legal, AE, CS, plus internal: lee (legal), security on-call, ir-bot.

lee: Forensics costs: default = customer pays external forensic vendors or for Redwood-conducted deep forensics (T&M). Exceptions only when negotiated in SOW and approved by RevOps/legal.

ana: can we include an evidence package we attach during incidents? Acme asked for SIG/CAIQ stuff on the fly.

colin: We can attach our completed SIG/CAIQ PDF and our standard artifact checklist (logs, timeline exports, config snapshots). Live forensic imaging or disk images are billable and need customer permission.

ravi: Also: redact PII and customer content when sharing internal artifacts; use secure links (time-limited).

megan: quick mitigation checklist to include in notify email:
- rotate exposed keys
- disable implicated endpoints
- preserve related logs/snapshots
- share session ids and request timestamps

colin: simple SOW clause you can paste: "Incident response and breach notification: Redwood will notify the customer designated security contact within 72 hours of confirming a security incident that affects customer data or service availability. For Hosted customers, Redwood will perform initial triage and provide regular updates; a final incident report will generally be delivered within 7-30 days (POC engagements typically target 10 business days). For Private/VPC/on-prem deployments, the customer retains responsibility for infrastructure-level forensic work; Redwood can assist with artifact collection and analysis upon request. For Dedicated Reserved Capacity customers, Redwood provides prioritized triage and expanded telemetry support. Any forensic services beyond initial triage are billable unless explicitly included in the SOW. Redwood will coordinate with the customer's security and legal contacts as specified in this agreement."

ana: perfect. i'll send to Acme. colin, can you attach SIG/CAIQ and the artifact checklist PDF?

colin: attaching now and creating incident ticket if needed.
